description.content: Start a new AI Architect chat for a dashboard or project.
List chats for the current company, optionally filtered by type.
Get a single chat by ID.
Hard-delete a chat and all its messages.
Soft-delete a chat and its associated pipeline or dashboard.
Signal the agent to cancel an in-progress generation for this chat.

Stream a chat attachment by storage key. Authz model: the signed ``token`` is the capability. Possession of a valid token grants read access for the token's TTL (7 days by default, matching the prior S3 presigned-URL behavior). The upload endpoint is still JWT-protected, so only authed users can ever obtain a valid token. ```` cannot send Authorization headers, so the JWT trust model doesn't work here — signed URLs do.
Upload a file attachment (image or PDF) for a chat message.
Add a message to a chat.
Return context usage info for the frontend indicator.
